headline: American business fears investing in Kyrgyzstan — US ambassador
summary: The US ambassador said unpredictable state procedures and insufficient transparency in business conditions remain obstacles to attracting American investment. The input gives no specific figures.
why: Foreign direct investment depends on regulatory predictability and transparency, which shape capital inflows into smaller emerging economies.
original_headline: Американский бизнес опасается вкладывать деньги в Кыргызстан — посол США
